fullDescription: A neo-brutalist SaaS design system for data infrastructure and AI-driven platforms. Featuring a high-contrast palette of cream, charcoal, and vibrant sky blue, this style utilizes thick 2px borders, hard offset shadows, and a mix of clean sans-serif and monospaced typography. Suitable for fintech, developer tools, cloud infrastructure, and modern data-heavy dashboards that require a clear, structured, and bold visual hierarchy.

structured.summary: Modern neo-brutalist SaaS landing page for data warehouses, characterized by a 'cream and charcoal' base, sharp edges, heavy non-blurred shadows, and tactical use of bright accent colors. The interface combines editorial typography with a technical developer-centric feel.

style.description: Neo-brutalist aesthetic using a light cream background (#f4efea) and dark charcoal text/borders (#383838). Typography pairs 'Satoshi' for clean readability with 'JetBrains Mono' for technical elements. Interactive elements feature sky-blue (#6fc2ff) and sun-yellow (#ffde00) accents. All borders are hard 2px lines, and shadows are solid offsets without blur.
style.prompt: Implement a neo-brutalist design style. Background: #f4efea. Primary Text & Borders: #383838. Accents: Sky Blue (#6fc2ff), Yellow (#ffde00), Orange (#ff9538). Typography: Headers in 'Satoshi' (700 weight), body in 'Satoshi' (300/400 weight), and technical UI elements in 'JetBrains Mono'. Borders: 2px solid #383838. Shadows: Solid -8px 8px 0px 0px #383838 (no blur). Hover states: Elements should translate upward and leftward (e.g., -4px, -4px) while maintaining the shadow position to create a 'lift' effect. Active states: remove shadow and reset transform to simulate a physical button press.

layout_and_structure.description: Centrally aligned hero section followed by a large, prominent dashboard or chat interface container. The layout uses a structured grid for content cards and a fixed-width container for the main application demo.

prompts.prompt: Create a centered hero section. Headline: All-caps 'JetBrains Mono' text, font-size: 60px, tracking-tight. Subheading: 'Satoshi' font, font-size: 20px, light weight (300), max-width: 42rem, color: rgba(56, 56, 56, 0.8). CTA Container: Horizontal flexbox with 24px gap. Primary CTA: Sky Blue (#6fc2ff) background, brutalist-border, uppercase font, right arrow icon. Secondary CTA: Cream (#f4efea) background, brutalist-border, uppercase font.

Design a container with a 2px solid #383838 border and a -8px 8px solid shadow. Header: Dark #383838 background, white text. Left side: Logo icon in orange box, 'Product Name' text, 'AI' badge in small grey box. Right side: Status pill in Yellow (#ffde00) with technical mono text. Main Area: Light grey (#f8f8f7) background. Content: A 3-column grid of report cards. Footer: Fixed input bar with 2px border, white background, and a square send button in grey that turns yellow on hover.

Scatter low-opacity (20%) geometric icons (clouds, triangles, cylinders) around the edges of the layout in various accent colors (#6fc2ff, #ff9538, #ffde00). Use an 'oscillation' animation (floating) on the main brand mascot icon located near the interface demo.

special_ui_components.description: Interactive data cards with a distinct header and image area.
special_ui_components.prompt: Component: Vertical card. Header: Sky Blue (#6fc2ff) background, 2px bottom border, white bold text (12px), centered. Body: Cream background containing a high-contrast image or chart. Interaction: On hover, apply -6px 6px solid #383838 shadow and scale internal image slightly (1.05x). Use a 2px solid #383838 border for the entire card.

special_ui_components.description: Compact technical indicator used for counters or labels.
special_ui_components.prompt: Background: #ffde00. Font: 'JetBrains Mono', 11px weight, uppercase. Padding: 6px 12px. Border: none. Text color: #383838. Use for 'credits left' or 'status' indicators.
